---
title: "Data Dictionary for Player Load Presentation"
format: html
---

## Variable Definitions

| Variable Name              | Operational Definition                                                                 |
|---------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `Date`                    | The calendar date when the session occurred.                                            |
| `Season`                  | The specific season or timeframe (e.g., Fall 2023) during which the session took place. |
| `About`                   | A brief descriptor or context for the session (e.g., practice, game).                   |
| `Position`                | The player's on-field or role-specific designation (e.g., Midfielder, Defender).        |
| `Period Number`           | A numerical value indicating the session segment (e.g., 1st half = 1, 2nd half = 2).    |
| `Period`                  | Label describing the time segment (e.g., "First Half").                                 |
| `Total Player Load`       | Total external workload derived from all directional accelerations over time.           |
| `Player Load Per Minute`  | Average player load per minute; calculated by dividing total player load by session time.|
| `IMA Accel High`          | Count of high-intensity acceleration events recorded during the session.                |
| `IMA Jump Count High Band`| Number of jumps recorded in the highest performance band based on vertical force data.  |
| `Session Total Jumps`     | Total number of jumps meeting defined criteria (e.g., flight time > 320ms, peak force). |

## Notes

- "Player Load" values are derived from Catapult sensor data using tri-axial accelerometers.
- "IMA" refers to Inertial Movement Analysis, a technique that captures micro-movements and rapid directional changes.
